Changes made
  firebase-app.js        none (byte-for-byte copy)
  firebase-messaging.js  one change: its import of
                         "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.19.0/firebase-app.js"
                         now points to "./firebase-app.js", so the app loads no code
                         from a third-party site.

Network calls these files make (only after someone taps "Turn on notifications")
  https://firebaseinstallations.googleapis.com  (creates the phone's Firebase installation ID)
  https://fcmregistrations.googleapis.com       (links that ID to the phone's push subscription)
